identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase II Clinical Trial of SHR-1826 for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study on the Efficacy, Safety, and Pharmacokinetics of SHR-1826 for Injection in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is a single-arm, open-label, multicenter phase II clinical trial aimed at evaluating the efficacy, safety, and pharmacokinetics of SHR-1826 in treating locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer . The recommended dose of SHR-1826 was administered via intravenous infusion once every 3 weeks (Q3W), with each treatment cycle lasting 21 days until meeting protocol-defined treatment discontinuation criteria.

primaryOutcomes.measure: ORR assessed by IRC according to RECIST v1.1 s）

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Objective Response Rate (ORR) assessed by the investigator according to RECIST v1.1;
Disease Control Rate (DCR) assessed by the IRC and investigator according to RECIST v1.1;
Duration of Response (DoR) assessed by the IRC and investigator according to RECIST v1.1;
Progression-Free Survival (PFS) assessed by the IRC and investigator according to RECIST v1.1;
